title: Smell test
what: You are asked to sniff different smells and name them or tell them apart. This shows the doctor how well you can smell.
why: When your sense of smell is reduced or gone, after a cold, a head injury, or for no clear reason.
duration: usually 15 to 30 minutes; the doctor tells you the findings during the visit
tell_doctor: When your sense of smell got worse and what came before it
If you had a runny or blocked nose, or nasal polyps
If you had a head injury

prepare.title: Scents
prepare.text: On the day of the test, do not wear perfume or scented cream.

prepare.title: Food and smoking
prepare.text: Do not smoke or eat spicy food for an hour before the test. Do not chew gum.

prepare.title: Nose
prepare.text: If your nose is blocked, tell the doctor beforehand. The test may be moved.

bring: Your referral, if you have one
steps: A small bottle or a special scented pen is held under your nose
You sniff for a few seconds
You choose the name of the smell from a list
Sometimes each nostril is tested separately
The smells change. There can be several dozen in total
feel: Some smells are hard to recognize. This is normal. Just answer with what you sense
after: The doctor explains the result and next steps
Sometimes smell training at home is prescribed
You may be referred for more tests of your nose

faq.q: Can my sense of smell come back?
faq.a: It often recovers, especially after a cold. Training helps, but it takes time.
Every day, you sniff a few familiar smells one by one. The doctor will show you how.

reminders.text: Smell test soon. Do not wear perfume or smoke before the test.
